desc: Design the algorithm: Use a wavelet tree to compute the sum of absolute differences between prefixes via a divide-and-conquer on the value range.
Coordinate compression of all values in A and B.
Build a wavelet tree for array A that supports prefix count and sum queries on value ranges.
Build a wavelet tree for array B similarly.
Implement the recursive function `solve(X, Y, L, R)` that computes the sum of |A_i - B_j| for the given prefixes using the wavelet trees.
Precompute prefix sums of the original arrays A and B.
Process each query by calling the recursive function and printing the result.
Test with the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
